researched.description: Carbon accounting and ESG disclosure software for enterprises, aimed mainly at manufacturers and their supply chains
researched.notes: Given URL www.asuene.com does not resolve; canonical US site is asuene.com/us. US subsidiary of Asuene Inc. (Tokyo), relocated from Los Angeles to Torrance. Horizontal ESG platform sold across industry verticals (automotive, electronics, chemicals, consumer goods), not a public-sector product, despite exhibiting at NACUBO. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Student information, finance, and HCM systems for colleges and universities
researched.notes: 1968 is the founding of predecessor Datatel, cited by company profile databases and consistent with Ellucian's own '50+ years' claim; the Ellucian brand itself dates to the 2012 Datatel/SunGard Higher Education merger. Worth a second look if exact-brand founding year matters.

researched.description: Student billing, payments, net price calculator, and pre-collections software for colleges and universities
researched.notes: Founding year not stated on the company site and not found by these searches.

researched.description: Campus commerce, tuition billing, and payment processing software for colleges and universities
researched.notes: touchnet.com returns Cloudflare 403 to both WebFetch and curl; details confirmed from TouchNet's own press/about listings and company directories. Owned by Global Payments.

researched.description: Volunteer, service-learning, and community engagement management software for universities, school districts, cities, and nonprofits
researched.notes: No URL was supplied; givepulse.com confirmed as the company's own site (about page states 2012 founding). Higher ed is its core market even though the source event was an animal welfare show.

researched.description: Loan origination, grants management, and fraud prevention platform for federal agencies
researched.notes: Federal-first (USDA, Dept. of Education, DFC) rather than state and local. FedRAMP High authorized. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Lease accounting and lease administration software for corporate, retail, and public-sector real estate portfolios
researched.notes: Horizontal lease accounting product sold across all industries; GASB 87 support is one compliance mode among ASC 842 and IFRS 16. Acquired Visual Lease, now merged into this brand. Part of CoStar Group. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Lease, debt, and accrual accounting automation software for finance teams in any industry
researched.notes: Formerly LeaseQuery. Horizontal accounting-compliance product; government issuers are one segment among corporates and CPA firms.

researched.description: Municipal bond market data, debt structuring, and issuer debt management software for government finance officers, underwriters, and municipal advisors
researched.notes: Judgment call: the flagship platform is an institutional muni desk sold to banks, advisors, and asset managers, while the government-facing product BondGov is free to issuers with paid workflow upgrades. Counted as govtech because the entire product is municipal-finance-specific, but the paying customer is often a financial intermediary.

researched.description: Accounting, payroll, and ERP software for small and mid-sized businesses across all industries
researched.notes: sage.com blocks automated fetch (Cloudflare 403) for both WebFetch and curl; details from company profile sources. Horizontal SMB accounting/ERP vendor with a public sector practice (Sage Intacct), not a govtech-specific product.

researched.description: No-code integration platform with prebuilt connectors linking government systems such as Accela, Tyler, and Laserfiche
researched.notes: HQ and founding year not on the company site; taken from its $11M Series A press coverage and Crunchbase/CB Insights profiles.

researched.description: Cloud infrastructure, database, ERP, and HCM software sold to enterprises and governments across every industry
researched.notes: Candidate was listed as the US operating entity Oracle America, Inc.; the canonical brand is Oracle (Oracle Corporation). Horizontal big-tech vendor with a public sector division, not a govtech-specific company.

researched.description: K-12 payments, meal account, forms, and ticketing software for school districts
researched.notes: Given URL i3education.org 301-redirects to i3verticals.com/education; PaySchools and SchoolPay are product brands of i3 Verticals' education segment. 2012 is the founding of parent i3 Verticals, Inc. (Nashville), not of the PaySchools brand.

researched.description: AI point-of-sale and dining operations software for K-12 school nutrition programs and campus dining
researched.notes: No URL was supplied; saavor.com confirmed as the company site. The site itself is nearly all images, so HQ and founding year come from CB Insights/Crunchbase-style profiles rather than the company's own pages. Techstars NYC alumnus.

researched.description: Construction contract administration software covering quantity take-off, bidding, field inspection, and payment certification for municipalities and civil engineering consultants
researched.notes: No URL was supplied. Product of AEC Solutions Inc., which rebranded to Builterra. The company site's footer address is Richmond Hill, ON while some directory listings say Oshawa, ON; used the company's own address. Founding year 2014 from its own press releases.

researched.description: No-code legal request intake, matter management, and workflow automation software for in-house legal teams
researched.notes: No URL was supplied; resolved to checkbox.ai (Checkbox Technology Pty Ltd), not the unrelated Checkbox survey software at checkbox.com. Horizontal legal-ops product whose named customers are corporates (BMW, PepsiCo, SAP, Deloitte); municipal law departments are one buyer type among many.

researched.description: AI health and well-being assessment platform used by Area Agencies on Aging to screen older adults and route them to local services
researched.notes: Given URL betterage.com refuses connections; the live site is betterage.net. Confirmed as the USAging exhibitor via the USAging/BetterAge national partnership announcement. NIH/NIA SBIR-funded ($5.5M in grants). Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Computer, smartphone, and tablet monitoring software for pretrial, probation, and parole supervision agencies
researched.notes: The public site is a thin login page with almost no company content; description and HQ assembled from its BBB listing, Crunchbase, and news coverage. Flagged the company disclosed a 2025 data breach of its monitoring product. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Psychological and risk-needs assessments delivered through an online assessment platform, sold to clinical, education, public safety, and corporate talent buyers
researched.notes: Judgment call: MHS is an assessment publisher rather than a pure software company, and it sells across clinical, education, corrections, and corporate HR. Its offender risk-needs instruments (LS/CMI, YLS/CMI) are the reason it exhibits at APPA, but the business is not government-specific.

researched.description: Inmate communications, tablets, electronic monitoring, and trust fund payment systems for corrections and community supervision agencies
researched.notes: Parent of Securus Technologies, Securus Monitoring, and JPay. Securus dates to 1986 but Aventiv is a later holding-company rebrand, so no founding year is recorded here rather than attributing the wrong one.

researched.description: Utility billing, customer information, and financial management ERP for municipal utilities and local governments
researched.notes: A division of N. Harris Computer Corporation (Constellation Software) since 2013. Company site now lists 1 Antares Drive, Ottawa, ON, the Harris campus address; older directory listings still show the original Charlottetown, PE base. Founding year 1997 from company profile databases, not the company site.

researched.description: Advisory and integration services helping water and wastewater utilities connect AMI, SCADA, and GIS systems
researched.notes: Reads as a consulting and enablement firm rather than a product company: the site describes strategies, programs, and coordination with no named software product, pricing, or demo. Positions itself as a Wetwork Group company, and Wetwork Group is a water utility advisory practice. HQ and founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: GeoViewer GIS asset management, field operations, and pressure monitoring software for water districts and municipal utilities
researched.notes: Founding year from Crunchbase/company directory listings; the company site states '32 years of experience,' consistent with 1992.

researched.description: Meter data management, utility analytics, and customer engagement software for electric, water, and gas utilities
researched.notes: A division of N. Harris Computer Corporation, sister unit to Cogsdale at the same Ottawa-area campus. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: SCADA software for monitoring and controlling water and wastewater treatment, pumping, and other utility infrastructure
researched.notes: Legal entity is Trihedral Engineering Limited, acquired by Delta Electronics in 2020. Judgment call on verdict: water and wastewater is its lead market and the reason it exhibits at AWWA, but VTScada is also sold into oil and gas, power generation, manufacturing, and marine, so an argument exists for scope review.

researched.description: Aerial imagery, 3D models, and AI-derived property data licensed to government, insurance, utilities, telecom, energy, and financial services
researched.notes: Given URL vexcelgroup.com did not respond; the live commercial site is vexceldata.com (footer entity Vexcel Imaging US, Inc.). Horizontal geospatial data business: government property assessment is one of eight named industries alongside insurance, which is the largest commercial segment. Founded 1992 in Graz, Austria as Vexcel Imaging; US group HQ now Boulder, CO.

researched.description: My Journey career planning, skills assessment, and case management platform for state workforce agencies, workforce boards, and schools
researched.notes: Acquired by DigiCap LLC in May 2025, and some recent press carries a Bethesda, MD dateline; the company's own contact page still lists 3330 Larimer Street, Denver, CO. Founding year from Crunchbase/CB Insights; one source says 2011.

researched.description: HIPAA-compliant client communication, scheduling, and case-note automation software for vocational rehabilitation and workforce development agencies
researched.notes: Part of Radicle Health since November 2022. Originated in 2015 out of the Council of State Administrators of Vocational Rehabilitation's WINTAC project; HQ and founding year from directory listings and the company's own acquisition announcement rather than an about page.

researched.description: Cyber risk scanning and portfolio monitoring software sold to insurance brokers, underwriters, financial services firms, and risk pools
researched.notes: General-purpose cyber risk analytics distributed mainly through the insurance channel; public entity risk pools are one buyer segment among brokers, carriers, and corporates. Backed by Verisk and BGF. HQ and founding year from funding press, not the company site.

researched.description: Web accessibility, content quality, analytics, and SEO software for organizations in government, higher education, healthcare, finance, and retail
researched.notes: Horizontal digital-presence platform; government and higher ed are two of many named verticals, with corporates such as Vodafone, BT, and Costco as flagship customers. Legal entity Siteimprove A/S.

researched.description: Cloud infrastructure, productivity, and AI software sold to enterprises, governments, and consumers worldwide
researched.notes: Big-tech horizontal vendor with a public sector division; not govtech-specific.

researched.description: Identity and access management, verification, and fraud protection software for large enterprises
researched.notes: General-purpose IAM: the company markets itself on Fortune 100 and large-bank adoption, with government as one vertical. Denver HQ confirmed on the company's contact page; founding year is from general reference sources, not the site. Owned by Thoma Bravo.

researched.description: Microsoft 365 tenant governance, configuration management, and license optimization software for enterprise IT teams
researched.notes: Horizontal Microsoft 365 management tool; named customers span higher ed, state government, banking, shipping, and nonprofits. Company lists a US HQ in Washington, DC, an EMEA HQ in Milan, Italy, and an Australian office. GovRAMP Premier Member. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Hybrid data lakehouse and enterprise AI platform sold to large organizations across all industries
researched.notes: General enterprise data platform (Global 2000 positioning) with public sector as one vertical. HQ and founding year could not be confirmed on cloudera.com itself; both come from general reference sources and should be spot-checked.

researched.description: Managed network detection and response and managed security operations for organizations with small IT teams
researched.notes: Formerly Sentinel IPS. Delivered largely as a managed service rather than self-serve software, and sold across local government, banking, healthcare, and higher ed, so it is horizontal cybersecurity rather than a govtech product. HQ and founding year from Crunchbase/ZoomInfo-style profiles.

researched.description: Digital courtroom audio and video recording, storage, and speech-to-text transcription software for courts
researched.notes: Also known as FTR. Tyler Technologies announced its acquisition of For The Record in February 2026 for about $212.5M and the company's own site confirms it has joined Tyler, so this may need to be merged into a Tyler record rather than tracked separately.

researched.description: Video meetings, phone, chat, and contact center software sold to businesses, schools, and governments
researched.notes: Renamed from Zoom Video Communications to Zoom Communications, Inc. in 2024. Horizontal communications platform; education and government are two of many named verticals.

researched.description: Cloud e-discovery, legal hold, and public records request automation for law firms, corporations, government agencies, and schools
researched.notes: Acquired by Reveal Data in August 2023 and now operates as a Reveal brand; the logikcull.com site is still live with its own product pages. Horizontal legal tech, with FOIA and public records handling as one workflow among corporate e-discovery use cases.

researched.description: ContentKeeper web filtering and StudentKeeper student safety monitoring software for K-12 school districts
researched.notes: Legal entity is Impero Solutions Ltd. trading as Ativion; ContentKeeper (founded 1998 in Canberra, Australia) was acquired by Impero in January 2022. Founding year 2002 refers to Impero and is reported as 2001 by some sources, so treat it as approximate. Backed by Investcorp.

researched.description: No-code digital forms, approval workflow, and e-signature software for K-12 school districts
researched.notes: HQ and founding year from PitchBook/Tracxn-style profiles and founder press; the company site does not state them. One source lists 2020 instead of 2018.

researched.description: Data warehouse and analytics platform that unifies SIS, LMS, assessment, and attendance data for K-12 schools and districts
researched.notes: Legal entity Intellischool Holdings Pty Ltd, with operations in Australia/New Zealand, Canada, and the US. Founding year not stated on the site and not found by these searches; the 2026 on the page is a copyright notice, not a founding date.

researched.description: Automatically maintained commercial sites and buildings listing database for economic development organizations
researched.notes: Customers named on the site are public and quasi-public EDOs, chambers, and city and county development authorities. HQ and founding year are not published anywhere on the site and were not found by these searches.

researched.description: Knowledge base, SOP authoring, and in-app agent guidance software for contact centers and regulated back offices
researched.notes: Horizontal knowledge-operations tool; the industries it names are credit unions, banks, farm credit associations, contact centers, and law firms, with human services agencies as an adjacent buyer. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Social program management platform for eligibility, enrollment, child welfare, and case management at health and human services agencies
researched.notes: No URL was supplied. Deployed by Minnesota, New York City, Canada, and Scotland. Merative's founding year is best recorded as the 2022 carve-out but is not stated on the page, so it is omitted.

researched.description: Program administration software for municipal CDBG, HOME, and housing rehabilitation funds covering intake, construction management, and monitoring

The site's copyright reads 2000-2026, which hints at a long history but is not a stated founding year. HQ not published on the site and not found by these searches.

researched.description: Payment gateway for card, ACH, and check payments taken by phone, web, and API, sold to lenders, collectors, healthcare billers, utilities, and government agencies
researched.notes: A brand of Autoscribe Corporation. Horizontal biller-facing payments processor; housing authorities and municipalities are one of five named verticals alongside collections and consumer finance.

researched.description: Platform for building and deploying AI clinical agents that automate patient-facing workflows for healthcare providers
researched.notes: Judgment call worth a second look: the buyers are clinics and health systems across primary care, orthopedics, women's health, oncology, and behavioral health, so it is a healthcare AI vendor rather than a public-agency product, despite exhibiting at NatCon. HQ and founding year are not published on the site and were not found by these searches.

researched.description: Digital substance use disorder prevention, intervention, and recovery support platform for treatment providers, state and county health agencies, drug courts, and Medicaid plans
researched.notes: Commercialized from the University of Wisconsin's A-CHESS research; the site's history page cites a 2014 JAMA Psychiatry study, a 2016 chairman appointment, and a 2017 CEO hire, but never states a founding year, so none is recorded.

researched.description: Behavioral health and wellbeing content, screening, and care-navigation platform deployed by public health departments, health plans, and health systems for their communities
researched.notes: Legal name CredibleMind, Inc. Partners include NACCHO and the American Hospital Association, and public health is a named buyer segment, but employers and commercial health plans are also core customers, so the public-sector share is worth checking. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Behavioral health electronic health record and revenue cycle software for mental health, substance use, IDD, and CCBHC providers and public health agencies
researched.notes: EnSoftek, Inc. is the legal entity; DrCloudEHR is the product. Second office in Hinsdale, IL. FedRAMP and FISMA High authorized. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: CRM, EMR, billing, and compliance platform for addiction treatment, eating disorder, and behavioral health facilities
researched.notes: Judgment call worth a second look: a real behavioral health software product, but its named market is private residential and outpatient treatment centers rather than county or state agencies, so it may not belong on a public-sector tracker. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: IEP compliance platform, universal mental health screening, and teletherapy staffing for school districts, provider networks, and state agencies
researched.notes: Hybrid model: the IEP and screening platform is real software, but a large share of the business is contracted clinician staffing and direct services, which is closer to a service provider than a product company. HQ not published on the site and not found by these searches.

researched.description: Electronic health record and clinical data platform for hospitals, health systems, and behavioral health providers
researched.notes: This is Oracle's healthcare division, the former Cerner, acquired by Oracle in 2022 and still operating from the Kansas City area campus. It is the same corporate entity as the separate Oracle candidate from PSHRA 2026, so the two should probably be merged rather than carded twice. Founding year omitted because Oracle (1977), Cerner (1979), and Oracle Health (2022) are three different dates.

researched.description: Case management EMR, outcome analytics, and revenue cycle platform for behavioral health and human services organizations
researched.notes: Low-confidence record: qualo.net renders entirely client-side, so both WebFetch and curl returned only navigation labels. The description is assembled from those labels (Case Management EMR, Behavioral Health, Human Services, Outcome Analytics Platform, Revenue Cycle Services) rather than from prose on the page. HQ, founding year, and the public-sector share of its customer base are all unconfirmed and should be checked by hand.

researched.description: Mobile-phone-based emergency dispatch and responder coordination software for EMS, fire, disaster response, and alternative crisis response teams
researched.notes: Trek Medics International is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, founded 2010, and Beacon is its software product, prototyped in 2012 and now used in 20+ countries; the nonprofit structure may matter for how this is carded. FirstNet certified. HQ city not published on the site and not found by these searches.

researched.description: Subscription American Sign Language video lesson library and dictionary for public libraries, schools, colleges, and public safety agencies
researched.notes: Institutional subscriptions are priced separately from individual ones, so libraries and schools are genuine buyers rather than incidental users. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Database of roughly 1.9 million US nonprofits plus grants and funder data, licensed to nonprofits, grantmakers, and public libraries
researched.notes: Candid is itself a 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 13-1837418) formed in 2019 by the merger of GuideStar and Foundation Center, so 2019 is the merged entity's date, not the lineage's. Its primary users are nonprofits and funders; public libraries are one distribution channel, which is why this is flagged rather than carded as govtech. HQ from general reference sources; the site's contact page did not resolve.

researched.description: US business and consumer reference databases, sold to marketers broadly and to libraries and academic institutions as Reference Solutions
researched.notes: Reference Solutions is the library-facing product line of a general-purpose B2B and consumer data company (formerly Infogroup), which is why this is scope review rather than govtech. Corporate locations listed are Grapevine TX, Boston MA, and Omaha NE, with Grapevine listed first; the site says 'since 1972' rather than naming a founding year outright.

researched.description: Hosted reference desk statistics tracking and reporting software for public and academic libraries
researched.notes: Operated by Sidecar Publications LLC, a two-person partnership; the site says 'made in Minnesota and Wisconsin' without naming a city, so no HQ is recorded. Founding year inferred from the site's own '2008-2026' copyright range rather than a stated date.

researched.description: Library website design, event and room booking calendars, and branding services for public libraries
researched.notes: Products are LibraryWebsite, LibraryCalendar, and LibraryBrand. The site states Library Market, LibraryIQ, and OrangeBoy now operate as one organization, so the corporate entity may have changed. Roughly half the offering (websites, branding) is agency-style service work rather than product. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Self-checkout software, kiosks, and RFID equipment for public, academic, and school libraries
researched.notes: Sells hardware kiosks and RFID gear alongside the app, so part of the revenue is equipment rather than software. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Digital ebook, audiobook, and video lending platform for public libraries, K-12 schools, and academic institutions
researched.notes: Consumer-facing apps are Libby, Sora, Kanopy, and TeachingBooks. Founding year 1986 is stated on the company's own history page; HQ is from general reference sources because the site does not publish an address.

researched.description: Stereo-video people counting sensors and occupancy analytics software for retail, libraries, museums, campuses, and public buildings
researched.notes: Horizontal traffic-analytics vendor: retail is listed first among ten industries, and the offering is a sensor-plus-software package with installation services, so it is part hardware business.

researched.description: Integrated library system, cataloging, and patron discovery software for public, school, and academic libraries
researched.notes: Known as TLC. Products include Library-Solution, CARL-Solution, ITS-MARC, and eBiblioFile; the site states continuous operation under the same ownership since 1974.

researched.description: Cloud patch management and endpoint vulnerability remediation software for IT teams across industries
researched.notes: Could not read the site: action1.com serves a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge to WebFetch and to curl with full browser headers, and the session's web search budget was exhausted before an alternate source could be checked. Verdict, description, and category rest on general knowledge of Action1 as a horizontal patch management vendor and should be verified by hand; HQ and founding year are deliberately omitted rather than guessed.

researched.description: Cloud virtual desktop and virtual computer lab software for universities, colleges, and schools
researched.notes: Education is the lead market at 350+ institutions, but Apporto also sells desktop-as-a-service to businesses, so it is not exclusively an education vendor. HQ and founding year are not published on the site and were not found by these searches.

researched.description: Learning management system plus accessibility and analytics tools for higher education, K-12, government, and corporate training
researched.notes: Corporate history is tangled: Blackboard merged with Anthology in 2021, and Anthology took the Blackboard name in 2025; the site footer reads Blackboard T&L, LLC. HQ is the Anthology/Blackboard Boca Raton base from general reference sources, not the site. Founding year 1997 is from the site's own 'Since 1997' line.

researched.description: Cloud digital signage content management and emergency messaging software for schools, campuses, offices, hospitals, and government buildings
researched.notes: A product of Tightrope Media Systems. Horizontal signage platform sold across five named industries. The site claims nearly 30 years in business but never states a founding year, so none is recorded.

researched.description: Data backup, cyber recovery, and identity resilience software for enterprises across all industries
researched.notes: Horizontal enterprise data protection vendor; government, healthcare, financial services, and education are named as verticals. Publicly traded (NASDAQ: CVLT). HQ and founding year from general reference sources, not the site.

researched.description: Event registration, venue sourcing, mobile app, and check-in software for event and marketing teams across all industries
researched.notes: Horizontal event management platform with a higher-ed page; the company markets on 89% of the Fortune 100 as customers. Legal name Cvent, Inc. Address from the site footer; founding year from general reference sources, matching the site's '25+ years' claim. Sector assignment is awkward: the product is event software, so it was mapped to Events & Tourism rather than to the conference it exhibited at.

researched.description: DNS, DHCP, and IP address management software with DNS security, sold to enterprises and service providers across all industries
researched.notes: Horizontal network infrastructure vendor; reference customers are Netflix, Heineken, Orange, Airbus, and Credit Agricole, with education one of six named verticals. Originally a French company (EfficientIP SAS); West Chester, PA is the address listed first on its contact page and appears to be the US HQ, so the corporate HQ in France is worth confirming. Founding year from the site's 'Since 2004'.

researched.description: Peer review, group work, and AI feedback tools that plug into university learning management systems
researched.notes: Second office in Boston, MA. Founding year from the company's own about page.

researched.description: Salesforce-native scheduling, booking, and resource reservation software sold across education, healthcare, hospitality, retail, and financial services
researched.notes: Horizontal Salesforce ISV listing ten industries; education is one. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: IT service management, enterprise service management, and CRM software sold across public sector, retail, education, healthcare, and financial services
researched.notes: Corporate entity is Halo Service Solutions; HaloITSM is one product alongside HaloPSA, HaloCRM, and HaloCSM. Horizontal service-desk vendor across roughly fifteen named industries. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: VALT video observation and recording software for nursing simulation labs, clinical skills training, courtrooms, and child advocacy centers
researched.notes: Known as IVS. Sells hardware and installation alongside the software, so part of the business is systems integration. Higher education is the lead market, with healthcare, government (law enforcement, courts, child advocacy), and corporate research as the others. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Wi-Fi-derived space utilization and occupancy analytics for university campuses and corporate real estate teams
researched.notes: Operates under parent Armored Things; 2017 comes from the about page's account of the company's origin. Corporate real estate is a co-equal market with higher ed, so it sits close to the scope-review line. HQ not published on the site and not found by these searches.

researched.description: VPN-free secure remote access to on-premises and cloud file servers, sold across healthcare, education, government, legal, finance, and manufacturing
researched.notes: Legal entity MyWorkDrive, LLC. Horizontal file-access product spanning seven named industries. HQ and founding year not published on the site and not found by these searches.

researched.description: Microsoft 365 workspace provisioning, lifecycle, and governance software for IT teams across construction, healthcare, higher education, legal, manufacturing, and public sector
researched.notes: Legal entity Orchestry Software Inc. Horizontal Microsoft ecosystem ISV; overlaps directly with the CoreView candidate from NASCIO 2026. HQ and founding year not published on the site and not found by these searches.

researched.description: Automated and guided web accessibility testing for university websites and Canvas course content
researched.notes: Built on the WAVE engine from WebAIM at Utah State University. Higher education is the core market, though the site also cites companies and nonprofits as customers. Legal name is Pope Tech Corporation per the candidate list; the site uses Pope Tech. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Enterprise Linux, Kubernetes, automation, and AI platform subscriptions sold to large organizations in every industry
researched.notes: An IBM subsidiary since 2019. Horizontal enterprise open source vendor with an academic program; not govtech-specific.

researched.description: Software that detects undisclosed AI assistance in live interviews, proctored exams, and recorded video sessions
researched.notes: Three named markets: technical hiring, higher education and certification proctoring, and assessment platforms, so corporate recruiting is co-equal with education. Site notes SDVOSB certification and FedRAMP-aligned controls. HQ and founding year are not published on the site and were not found by these searches; the company appears to be very early stage.

researched.description: Work and project portfolio management platform sold to enterprises across every industry
researched.notes: Horizontal work management vendor marketing on 85%+ Fortune 500 adoption; government and higher education are two of six named verticals. Legal name Smartsheet Inc. HQ and founding year from general reference sources because the site does not publish either.

researched.description: No-code IT service management, asset management, project portfolio, and integration platform for universities, school districts, and government agencies
researched.notes: No URL was supplied; teamdynamix.com confirmed as the company site. Close to the scope-review line: higher ed, K-12, and public sector lead its market list, but it also sells to healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, hospitality, and retail, which makes it arguably horizontal ITSM like the HaloITSM candidate. Portfolio company of K1 Investment Management.

researched.description: Live classroom polling and interactive question software for university instructors and corporate trainers
researched.notes: Higher education is the lead market (Duke, HEC Paris, University of Edinburgh) but corporate L&D is a stated second market, so the public-sector share is worth checking. HQ and founding year from general reference sources; neither appears on the site's about or contact pages.
